answer: The minimum age to attend Riverside Festival is 16. Visitors aged 16 or 17 must show a valid ID at the entrance to receive a wristband that does not allow them to buy alcohol. Children under 16 are not allowed, even with an adult.
Riverside Festival takes place from Friday 16 July to Sunday 18 July 2027.
Yes! During the festival, a free shuttle bus runs between Tiel station and the festival entrance every 10 minutes, from 11:30 until one hour after the last show.
Unused digital tokens are refunded automatically to your bank account within 14 days after the festival, minus a €1 administration fee. Physical tokens cannot be refunded.
